sloka: अप्सु निर्मथनात् एव रसात् तस्मात् वर स्त्रियः ।उत्पेतुः मनुज श्रेष्ठ तस्मात् अप्सरसो अभवन् ॥१-४५-३३॥
transliteration: apsu nirmathanāt eva rasāt tasmāt vara striyaḥ ।utpetuḥ manuja śreṣṭha tasmāt apsaraso abhavan ॥1-45-33॥

translations.english: O Kakutstha there appeared sixty crore highly lustrous apsarasas. Their attendants were countless in number.
